res.rule: R1 digits only on stop tags and Places clusters

R1 (r18) a single stop pin shows its number in place of its glyph: grey (--ink-2; paper when selected), ≥12px, no glyph; a cluster’s stop tag is a grey ring on paper (r19: circle for one number, pill for more), never a solid disc; clusters are red discs
R2 (r17) every stop in view is either its own pin at its true location or a member of a Places cluster (stops cluster like any pin)
R3 every place below the rule in view is a Places pin or in a Places cluster (25 rows)
R3 no clusters at or above SOLO_MIN_ZOOM (as in Places)
R4 (r16/r17) every Places cluster’s count is on top and ≥60% of its disc is exposed (1 clusters)
R4 (r17/r19) every stop in view has its number on a visible, uncovered tag: its own pin, or its cluster’s
R4 (r17) no tag ever covers a cluster’s count
R4 (r18) a cluster’s stop tag sits flush against its count (0–2.5px from the digits: beside them, level, or above/below them, centred; never over them)
